title: field encodings
property: outputs are field elements (< p); revKey < 2^251 and equals hi * 2^123 + floor(lo / 32) of the credID limbs; fieldFrom31Bytes equals the big-endian integer of exactly 31 bytes; each throws Error exactly on its documented bad input (empty or non-string typeId, length other than 31 or 32, threshold outside [0, 255], invalid date, unknown predicate, value outside [0, p)); typeIds that differ only in lone surrogates are recorded as an observation when they collide
